tools.name: generate_handwriting_sheet
tools.description: Use this when the user wants handwriting worksheets, tracing worksheets, letter tracing or handwriting practice sheets as a printable vector PDF. Supports up to 600 characters and word wrapping. Repeats text to fill each tracing row when repetitions are omitted, or uses an explicit one to four copie

tools.name: generate_name_tracing_sheet
tools.description: Use this when the user wants name tracing worksheets or a custom tracing worksheet as a printable PDF. Supports a name up to 40 characters and 1 to 30 total writing rows, alternating trace and blank rows starting with trace. Does not support cursive. Print letters only. Latin, Greek and Cyrillic sup

tools.name: generate_lined_paper
tools.description: Use this when the user wants printable lined paper or kindergarten writing paper as a vector PDF. Produces 1 to 20 pages with solid top and baseline guides, descender space and an optional dashed midline. Four body heights, Letter or A4, portrait or landscape. Does not produce cursive examples.
